description: Rank GPU instances by price per GPU per hour (USD). Filter by gpu_model (e.g. A100), provider, region, or charge_type. Returns the cheapest N per-GPU options.

charge_type.description: pricing model: on_demand, subscription, reserved, or spot

continent.description: restrict to a continent: NA (North America), SA, EU, AS (Asia), AF, OC (Oceania)

country.description: ISO country code to restrict regions, e.g. US, CN, SG

gpu_model.description: GPU model to match, e.g. A100, H100, T4

include_burstable.description: also return burstable (CPU credits/baseline: AWS t3, Azure B, Alibaba t6, Huawei t6/at7) and shared-core (GCP e2-micro, Linode/Vultr shared CPU) instances; excluded by default because their price buys a CPU baseline, not a full core

limit.description: max rows to return (default 20, hard cap 50)

max_hourly_usd.description: maximum price in USD per hour

near.description: free-text place (city/region) to find nearby regions, e.g. Singapore, Tokyo, us-east-1

payment_option.description: for reserved: all_upfront, partial_upfront, or no_upfront

provider.description: cloud provider, e.g. AWS, Azure, AlibabaCloud, GCP; omit for all

query.description: substring match on instance type name

term.description: for reserved/subscription: contract length, e.g. 1 or 3 (years)

name: gpu_options
title: GPU price per GPU-hour
